steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Finally, you let me in.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Judging from the storm outside, I thought your inner world would be more turbulent.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Lies... lies... liar.
Deep inside her consciousness, Eve is still immersed in chaos.
First, she needs to sober up to continue the conversation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've seen a lot of things about you here. But this is the first time we're face-to-face for a good chat.
Eve stares blankly at the ground, and you continue to patiently communicate.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I remember correctly, you helped Bass and Benna fix the machine, right?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Bass, Benna... fake...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, they are just toys that you designated as your family members. But I believe the memories you shared are real, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In those memories, they trusted you and believed that you could fix the machine.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: ...Trusted...
You seem to elicit some reaction. You continue with the next topic.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And, the scene where you found Bone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To that little puppy, you were probably a savior, right?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Take a walk...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah... unfortunately, the promise to take a walk could not be fulfilled...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Polly's a nice girl, isn't she?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yes, kind, brave...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As you said, she deserves the most beautiful doll.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maresa... Although she didn't find her own child, she actually has a lot of children here.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You saw... a lot...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, I saw everything, including the explosion.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Somebody told me that you were able to build this factory where toys come alive thanks to a powerful wish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I'm not mistaken, your wish is...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>To stay here forever with your family</color>... right?
Eve's eyelashes flutter.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But is this really what they want?
You hold Eve's hand, pressing her palm tightly against the photo.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Listen carefully. All the personalities, identities and memories you painstakingly created with the toys... What wishes have sprung forth from them?

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: I wish that in my next life, I'll meet Eve again! By then, we will be complete, healthy and well.

steps.speaker: Benna
steps.content: All right. Then I wish that in this life, Eve can leave the factory, and live a long, happy and peaceful life.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Bass hope Eve can make new friends! Friends smarter than Bass, so Eve won't be troubled! If Eve is happy, Bass is happy!

steps.speaker: Bone
steps.content: Woof, woof! Woof, woof, woof, woof!

steps.speaker: Maresa
steps.content: Then let me make the last wish. I hope, all our wishes can come true.

steps.speaker: Bass & Benna
steps.content: Eve?

steps.speaker: Polly & Maresa
steps.content: Eve!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eve.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Their wish is for you to experience tomorrow outside the factory.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's a tomorrow that belongs to you, and one that you'll witness on their behalf.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because of you, this family without blood ties exists.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you move forward, the family members in your memory will also move forward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. You were never a burden. You are their hope and continuity for the future.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's go. I'll take you away from here.
Her eyes regain their sparkle. At the same time, a sea of emotions is awakened in an instant, amplified infinitely across her consciousness.

Her monochrome consciousness suddenly becomes a kaleidoscope of colors. You feel an intense emotion... partially guilt, and partially the exhaustion of repeating memories in a false paradise day after day. She lifts her head, looking somewhat bewildered through the mist in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Are you that cotton doll? You look better than when you were a toy.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I remember... I was celebrating Bone's birthday.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And then I came in and caused a mess, and you caught me.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I hurt you... I hurt many others too, didn't I? I... I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know. You just wanted to recreate a place where you're accompanied by your toy family.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: As long as I leave here, everything will get better?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course. The Buonanotte Factory was created from your wish. Things will get better as long as you are willing to let go of your wish.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I see, I see... As long as I leave here, everything will get better...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. Things haven't gotten too bad yet. It's just that you unintentionally trapped some people in this factory, and they had a long nap. There is still room to recalibrate your Mania risk level.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I will find someone to heal your legs, so that you may carry on the existence of your family members in this world. As long as you remember, they are not gone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Keep moving forward along with your memories. I believe you will make new friends at the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Friends?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Someone asked me to give you a message.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's an inventor. She discovered the intricacies of some old toys from the Buonanotte Factory and specially came here to get inspiration.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She said that she saw many toys that you designed in the factory that are both exquisite and meticulously crafted. Thanks to you, she has many new inventions in her head that she wants to realize.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She wants me to tell you that you're amazing!
Perhaps because she's been with the toys for too long, she seems surprised and flustered at such sincere and frank compliments. You seize the opportunity to offer her your hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll take you out of here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is also their wish.

She looks at the hand in front of her, staring for a long time before she carefully holds up your fingertips. She sees the wounds from your journey to her, and also feels the real warmth that reminds her of her family.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: "What will happen tomorrow?" Only after you said all this do I realize that I haven't thought about this question for a long time.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The world you promised sounds wonderful. I like it.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: After going out, I can start a new life, meet new friends. I can also make a lot of toys... It'll be great.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Thank you for bringing their voices to me, for letting me hear their wishes. Now, let me do something for you, too.
She releases your hand, and conjures up a match in the sea of consciousness.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I remember... Bone's birthday isn't over yet. It's time to light a birthday candle... I'll leave the outside world to you.
With a crackle, the warm dancing flame pulls you back to reality.
The tyrannical giant toy bear is rampaging amidst a sea of flames, destroying everything in its path. Fire is rapidly spreading over its body, burning it from the inside out.

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Ah!!! It's so hot! Eve! What are you doing inside there?!</color>

steps.speaker: Toy Bear
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Stop it! Stop it right now!</color>
